hooks.text: 物品效果由摆放位置、触发点方向与连接条件共同决定，移动物品即可改变触发频率和路线。
hooks.excerpt: Item effects depend not only on stats, but on trigger point direction and linkage conditions from positioning. Change positions to alter frequency and routes, creating your own chain rhythm.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 不同形状与尺寸的物品争夺有限格位，玩家需权衡主动触发和被动效果来优化空间组合。
hooks.excerpt: Items vary in shape and size. Weigh active triggers against passive effects, carefully managing limited slots to find the optimal combination.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 各英雄专属物品会建立不同系统，并以 20 档难度和机制型怪物检验构筑深度。
hooks.excerpt: Each hero's exclusive items build different systems. Multiple tactical combinations meet 20 difficulty levels and unique mechanic monsters, relentlessly testing the depth of your builds.
